title: Insure residential building work (home warranty)
what: As the licensed builder, include a residential building insurance policy (or an insurer's certificate, or a fidelity certificate) with the application for a commencement notice for insurable residential building work.

sources.title: Building Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 37(4) (current republication (R57, from 10 November 2026; Building Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: If the application is for insurable residential building work, the application must be accompanied by— (a) a residential building insurance policy for the work; or (b) a certificate issued by an approved insurer stating that the insurer has insured the work under a residential building insurance policy; or (c) a fidelity certificate for the work
